elements.label: Figure O.9
elements.title: Standards can be used in regulation in a variety of ways
elements.content:
Standard -> Law:
- ISO XXXX: 2018 (Text of standard) -> 1. Delegate: XYZ needs to develop standards.
- ISO XXXX: 2018 (Text of standard) -> 2. Optional use (with or without legal benefit): Products must be safe., Sulfate levels must not exceed 50 mg/kg., Compliance can be demonstrated by using ISO XXX: 2018 or other means.
- ISO XXXX: 2018 (Text of standard) -> 3. Reference: Shall conform to ISO XXXX: 2018., Shall conform to the latest edition of ISO XXXX.
- ISO XXXX: 2018 (Text of standard) -> 4. Integrate: Replicate text of standard (in parts or whole).

Decreasing flexibility arrow on the right side pointing downwards.

Source: WDR 2025 team.
Note: ISO = International Organization for Standardization; mg/kg = milligrams per kilogram.
